section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1968
title: On an average, 60.1% of suicides are committed by males, while persons in the age group of 18 to 30 years are more prone to commit suicides and they accounted for 43.7% of the total suicides during 1968. Among the causes of suicides, despair over dreadful diseases was the major cause accounting for 17.4% of the total suicidal deaths while quarrels with the married partner or parents-in-law together accounted for 14.4% of all suicidal deaths. Table 7 furnishes statistics of the incidence of suicides due to various causes. TABLE 7 Incidence of Suicides in India by causes, 1968
